text:
maya: Heads-up: noticed invoice-preview for several tenants flicker to zero around 03:22 UTC during last SKU rollout. Console shows a brief gap then values recover. Filing here before triage.

tariq: can you paste a sample trace? guessing route rebinding + heartbeat TTLs again.

maya: sample tenant `spark-retail`, trace `tr-zz42`. ingest log snippet:
```
2024-11-05T03:21:58Z INFO route-resolver bind sku=canary-us -> route:r14
2024-11-05T03:22:00Z WARN quota-heartbeat missing tenant=spark-retail window=60s
2024-11-05T03:22:01Z INFO metering-event emitted tokens=203 route=r14 fingerprint=fp-77aa session_id=sess-9
```

ben: i inspected the dedupe logic. current dedupe key = `tenant|fingerprint|route_resolution_id`. If route_resolution_id changes mid-session, preview aggregation's dedupe treats events as distinct and ordering causes transient zeros.

maya: confirmed fingerprint constant, route_resolution_id flips r13->r14. interestingly, the billing ledger (post-finalize path) remains correct; this seems isolated to preview aggregation.

pm-lucy: product asks for per-SKU preview fidelity. We can't just drop route id from dedupe globally. Need a way to keep per-route visibility while avoiding preview noise.

tariq: suggestion: create preview-only aliasing at ingest: detect consecutive events with same tenant+fingerprint+session within small window and link their route_resolution_ids to a canonical preview id. Use that canonical id in preview dedupe only. Billing path unchanged.

ben: implementation notes: add an in-memory short-lived map keyed by tenant|session|fingerprint -> canonical_preview_route (TTL 90s). On route flip, ingest writes alias relation: `{observed_route: r14, canonical_route: r13}`. Preview dedupe resolves via the map.

telemetry-bot: METRIC spike: quota-heartbeat-jitter 03:20-03:24 (chart link: http://dash/heartbeat?from=03:00&to=04:00)

infra-bot: NOTICE partition-2 lag 03:20-03:25 consumer-lag=12s. deploy window ongoing.

ben: risks: if we alias incorrectly we could collapse genuine retries that should be dropped. Mitigation: only alias when session_id present and fingerprint unchanged AND event timestamps within the TTL. Also tag preview events as `preview_alias=true` for audit.

pm-lucy: please add a console tooltip: "Preview may group transient route changes for short windows; invoice calculations are unaffected." Product wants explicit language.

tariq: plan: implement preview aliasing behind a feature flag `preview_canonicalization`. Canary to 3% tenants for 2h, observe `preview_alias_count` and `invoice_preview_diff_pct`. If alias reduces preview spikes without increasing final billing diffs, expand rollout.

maya: qa checklist: unit tests for alias map, integration test across ingest->preview path simulating rX->rY flips, and ensure no cross-tenant leakage.

ben: i'll open PR and add logging event `preview_alias_emitted {tenant,fingerprint,session,observed,canonical}`. telemetry-bot will surface a per-tenant counter.

telemetry-bot: NEW_METRIC preview_alias_count emitted to metrics pipeline.

pm-lucy: timeline request: can we have a canary by tomorrow morning UTC? means we need the PR + tests today.

maya: copying ops: please monitor support queues for early signals.

ben: noted. also will add a console banner on the preview panel during canary explaining canonicalization is active.

tariq: follow-up: we should audit other dedupe keys that include mutable routing metadata (region, sku tags). i'll add a ticket to the backlog.

maya: thanks all — this should reduce confusing preview zeros for customers. Will update thread with PR link and canary results.
